ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across >95% of the visible surface area, with isolated high-intensity (white) pixel clusters providing high local contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark field with sparse, high-contrast white circular focal points (<10 pixels in diameter) distributed stochastically across the mid-lobe regions and with higher density along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a narrow angular aperture and deep penetration towards the peduncle insertion point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern featuring sharp, non-uniform peaks and shallow valleys across the continuous boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave sweep on the distal edges leading to acutely pointed, upward-curving lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with sessile organism attachment sites, concentrated on the outer lobe margins and distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white scarring and rosette patterns distributed across the ventral surface, particularly dense at the trailing edge margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced recurved and sharpened geometry of the lateral fluke tips.
